BEFORE WE HIT THE ROAD

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Who is this built for?+

Established North American fleets with 20 or more trucks, contracted or dedicated freight, and a meaningful driver recruiting challenge. The initial conversation helps clarify your needs and fit.

What does the partnership focus on?+

Driver recruiting, outreach, and marketing. This concept presents a connected approach to positioning, driver conversations, and a repeatable recruiting process. The actual scope would be agreed with the GetTruckDrivers team.

Can this work with our existing team?+

The direction is to support the people who know your fleet best. A discovery conversation would cover your current recruiting process, team capacity, and the gaps you want to address.

Is this the official GetTruckDrivers website?+

This is an independent portfolio concept designed and developed by Yash Patel. The interactive calculator, film, and editorial content demonstrate the proposed experience. Visit gettruckdrivers.com for official services and booking.
